exposure: surgical management (hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, cystectomy, unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy)
outcome: effectiveness and tolerability of EP chemotherapy
cohort: The cohort consisted of 27 women older than 18 years with ovarian immature teratoma (IT) stages IA to IIIC.
finding: Ovarian immature teratoma is a curable disease, and etoposide/cisplatin (EP) chemotherapy is an effective and well-tolerated primary treatment, particularly when combined with fertility-sparing surgery.
